═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                     YIJIANG (WILLIAM) LI  黎羿江
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Hi! I am Yijiang (William) Li.

I am a PhD student in Machine Learning and Data Science (ECE) at [UC San Diego](https://ucsd.edu/), supported by the Jacobs Fellowship.

I am interested in the **learning** aspects of AI: how to make learning **efficient** (label- and sample-efficient learning, synthetic data) and **robust**, and how that plays out for **multi-modal, interactive and 3D embodied** agents. Some questions I keep coming back to:
1. What do multi-modal LLMs actually know? Understanding and evaluating them, e.g. through the lens of [core knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10855).
2. Can language, which is semantic, abstract and compositional, scaffold vision learning, e.g. as an anchor representation?
3. The intrinsic 3D world: 3D-aware architectures for MLLMs, and 3D representations that emerge from 2D supervision.
4. Embodiment, learning from indirect (often social) feedback, and learning while inferring.

I am also broadly interested in applications of AI: LLM agents ([MAS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.07461)), AI for science and AI for health.

Before UCSD, I earned my M.S.E. in Computer Science at [Johns Hopkins University](https://www.jhu.edu/) and my B.E. in Computer Science at South China University of Technology. I have had the privilege of working with Prof. [Alan Yuille](https://www.cs.jhu.edu/~ayuille/) as a research assistant in [CCVL](https://ccvl.jhu.edu/), and with Prof. [Haohan Wang](https://haohanwang.github.io/) at [DREAM Lab](https://dreamlabuiuc.github.io/), UIUC. I have also spent time as a research intern at the [Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence](https://www.baai.ac.cn/en/) and [SenseTime Research](https://www.sensetime.com/en).

I co-founded [GrowAI](https://growing-ai-like-a-child.github.io/), a research organization and community promoting research on AI that can learn and grow like humans.
